prerequisites: Knowledge of programming from the first two semesters, which will be built upon for Android Studio, XCode, Kotlin, and Swift.

learning_outcomes.text: Students gain a deep insight into the development of mobile applications using concrete development environments and frameworks (Flutter, Android Studio, and XCode).
Students know and understand essential conditions and processes in the development of mobile applications.
Students can define the essential characteristics of various approaches and acquire basic knowledge in the integration of device functions (sensor technology, network, etc.) of mobile devices.
Graduates can reflect on the use of techniques and concepts for designing mobile applications.
Graduates independently develop solutions and implement state-of-the-art applications.
Students analyze and evaluate development concepts and frameworks for mobile application development on a sound basis. They present their own implementations in a well-structured and coherent form.
Students can develop mobile applications based on methodical knowledge, from requirements analysis through the reflective use of system concepts to implementation.

syllabus_topics: Overview of development approaches (native, hybrid, cross-platform)
Structure of platforms and development environments (Android & iOS)
Integration of sensor technology and network components
assessment_rules: The graded examination can be either a project report or an oral examination. The project report typically involves creating, testing, and evaluating a mobile application, with an expected length of approximately 15 pages and a 10-minute explanation. For the oral examination, the general part of the examination regulations applies.
